title: The Purpose Behind the Message
learning_focus: Author purpose, message, target audience, point of view, tone, mood, and visual purpose.
story_premise: Five messages about the same regional event produce different reactions because each was designed for a different audience.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Author purpose, message, target audience, point of view, tone, mood, and visual purpose.
